      "content": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, CheckConstraint, Index\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base\n\nBase = declarative_base()\n\nclass User(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"users\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    username = Column(String, unique=True, nullable=False)\n    full_name = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String, unique=True)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Animal(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"animals\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    species = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    breed = Column(String)\n    birth_date = Column(Date)\n    gender = Column(String, CheckConstraint(\"gender IN ('Male','Female','Unknown')\"))\n    intake_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"Available\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('Available','Adopted','Foster','Medical Hold','Deceased')\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Veterinarian(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"veterinarians\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    name = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    license_number = Column(String, unique=True)\n    clinic_name = Column(String)\n    phone = Column(String)\n    email = Column(String)\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass MedicalEvent(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"medical_events\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    event_type = Column(String, nullable=False, CheckConstraint(\"event_type IN ('Spay/Neuter','Vaccination','Checkup','Dental','Surgery','Injury','Illness','Other')\"))\n    event_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    description = Column(String)\n    veterinarian_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"veterinarians.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Vaccination(Base):\n    __tablename__ = \"vaccinations\"\n\n    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)\n    animal_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"animals.id\", ondelete=\"CASCADE\"), nullable=False)\n    vaccine_type = Column(String, nullable=False)\n    vaccination_date = Column(Date, nullable=False)\n    next_due_date = Column(Date)\n    status = Column(String, default=\"Completed\", CheckConstraint(\"status IN ('Completed','Pending','Overdue','Missed')\"))\n    veterinarian_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"veterinarians.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    medical_event_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey(\"medical_events.id\", ondelete=\"SET NULL\"))\n    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)\n    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)"

      "content": "from pydantic import BaseModel\nfrom datetime import date, datetime\nfrom typing import List, Optional\n\n\nclass MedicalEventSpayNeuterMissingRabiesOut(BaseModel):\n    animal_id: int\n    animal_name: str\n    surgery_date: date\n    vaccination_status: Optional[str] = None\n    last_vaccine_date: Optional[date] = None\n    next_due_date: Optional[date] = None\n    veterinarian_name: Optional[str] = None\n\n    class Config:\n        from_attributes = True\n\nclass MedicalEventsSpayNeuterNoRabiesOut(BaseModel):\n    animal_id: int\n    animal_name: str\n    surgery_date: date\n    vaccination_status: Optional[str] = None\n    last_vaccine_date: Optional[date] = None\n    next_due_date: Optional[date] = None\n    veterinarian_name: Optional[str] = None\n\n    class Config:\n        from_attributes = True\n\nclass VaccinationsMissingRabiesOut(BaseModel):\n    animal_id: int\n    animal_name: str\n    surgery_date: Optional[date] = None\n    vaccination_status: Optional[str] = None\n    last_vaccine_date: Optional[date] = None\n    next_due_date: Optional[date] = None\n    veterinarian_name: Optional[str] = None\n\n    class Config:\n        from_attributes = True"

      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom typing import List\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import MedicalEvent, Vaccination, Animal, Veterinarian\nfrom schemas import MedicalEventSpayNeuterMissingRabiesOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/animals\",\n    tags=[\"Animals\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/medical-events/spay-neuter-missing-rabies\", operation_id=\"get_spay_neuter_missing_rabies_events\")\nasync def get_spay_neuter_missing_rabies_events(\n    limit: int = Query(None, ge=1),\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Calculate the date 6 months ago\n    six_months_ago = datetime.utcnow().date() - timedelta(days=180)\n\n    # Subquery to find animals with recent spay/neuter events\n    spay_neuter_subq = (\n        db.query(MedicalEvent.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\",\n            MedicalEvent.event_date >= six_months_ago\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Subquery to find animals with completed rabies vaccinations\n    completed_rabies_subq = (\n        db.query(Vaccination.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\",\n            Vaccination.status == \"Completed\"\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Main query to get animals with spay/neuter but missing rabies\n    query = (\n        db.query(\n            Animal.id.label(\"animal_id\"),\n            Animal.name.label(\"animal_name\"),\n            MedicalEvent.event_date.label(\"surgery_date\"),\n            Vaccination.status.label(\"vaccination_status\"),\n            Vaccination.vaccination_date.label(\"last_vaccine_date\"),\n            Vaccination.next_due_date.label(\"next_due_date\"),\n            Veterinarian.name.label(\"veterinarian_name\")\n        )\n        .join(spay_neuter_subq, Animal.id == spay_neuter_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .outerjoin(completed_rabies_subq, Animal.id == completed_rabies_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .outerjoin(MedicalEvent, \n                   (MedicalEvent.animal_id == Animal.id) & \n                   (MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\") & \n                   (MedicalEvent.event_date >= six_months_ago))\n        .outerjoin(Vaccination,\n                   (Vaccination.animal_id == Animal.id) &\n                   (Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\") &\n                   (Vaccination.status == \"Completed\"))\n        .outerjoin(Veterinarian, MedicalEvent.veterinarian_id == Veterinarian.id)\n        .filter(completed_rabies_subq.c.animal_id.is_(None))\n    )\n\n    if limit:\n        query = query.limit(limit)\n\n    results = query.all()\n\n    # Convert to Pydantic models\n    records = [MedicalEventSpayNeuterMissingRabiesOut.model_validate(row) for row in results]\n\n    return {\"records\": records}"
    },

      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom typing import List\n\nfrom database import get_db\nfrom models import MedicalEvent, Vaccination, Animal, Veterinarian\nfrom schemas import MedicalEventsSpayNeuterNoRabiesOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(\n    prefix=\"/api/medical-events\",\n    tags=[\"MedicalEvents\"]\n)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/spay-neuter-no-rabies\", operation_id=\"medical_events_get_spay_neuter_no_rabies_events\")\nasync def medical_events_get_spay_neuter_no_rabies_events(\n    days_back: int = Query(180, ge=1),\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Calculate the date based on days_back\n    cutoff_date = datetime.utcnow().date() - timedelta(days=days_back)\n\n    # Subquery to find animals with recent spay/neuter events\n    spay_neuter_subq = (\n        db.query(MedicalEvent.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\",\n            MedicalEvent.event_date >= cutoff_date\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Subquery to find animals with completed rabies vaccinations\n    completed_rabies_subq = (\n        db.query(Vaccination.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\",\n            Vaccination.status == \"Completed\"\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Main query to get animals with spay/neuter but missing rabies\n    query = (\n        db.query(\n            Animal.id.label(\"animal_id\"),\n            Animal.name.label(\"animal_name\"),\n            MedicalEvent.event_date.label(\"surgery_date\"),\n            Vaccination.status.label(\"vaccination_status\"),\n            Vaccination.vaccination_date.label(\"last_vaccine_date\"),\n            Vaccination.next_due_date.label(\"next_due_date\"),\n            Veterinarian.name.label(\"veterinarian_name\")\n        )\n        .join(spay_neuter_subq, Animal.id == spay_neuter_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .outerjoin(completed_rabies_subq, Animal.id == completed_rabies_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .outerjoin(MedicalEvent, \n                   (MedicalEvent.animal_id == Animal.id) & \n                   (MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\") & \n                   (MedicalEvent.event_date >= cutoff_date))\n        .outerjoin(Vaccination,\n                   (Vaccination.animal_id == Animal.id) &\n                   (Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\") &\n                   (Vaccination.status == \"Completed\"))\n        .outerjoin(Veterinarian, MedicalEvent.veterinarian_id == Veterinarian.id)\n        .filter(completed_rabies_subq.c.animal_id.is_(None))\n    )\n\n    results = query.all()\n\n    # Convert to Pydantic models\n    records = [MedicalEventsSpayNeuterNoRabiesOut.model_validate(row) for row in results]\n\n    return {\"records\": records}"
    },

Calculate the date 6 months ago\n    six_months_ago = datetime.utcnow().date() - timedelta(days=180)\n\n    # Subquery to find animals with recent spay/neuter events\n    spay_neuter_subq = (\n        db.query(MedicalEvent.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\",\n            MedicalEvent.event_date >= six_months_ago\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Subquery to find animals with completed rabies vaccinations\n    completed_rabies_subq = (\n        db.query(Vaccination.animal_id)\n        .filter(\n            Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\",\n            Vaccination.status == \"Completed\"\n        )\n        .subquery()\n    )\n\n    # Main query to get animals with spay/neuter but missing rabies\n    query = (\n        db.query(\n            Animal.id.label(\"animal_id\"),\n            Animal.name.label(\"animal_name\"),\n            MedicalEvent.event_date.label(\"surgery_date\"),\n            Vaccination.status.label(\"vaccination_status\"),\n            Vaccination.vaccination_date.label(\"last_vaccine_date\"),\n            Vaccination.next_due_date.label(\"next_due_date\"),\n            Veterinarian.name.label(\"veterinarian_name\")\n        )\n        .join(spay_neuter_subq, Animal.id == spay_neuter_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .outerjoin(completed_rabies_subq, Animal.id == completed_rabies_subq.c.animal_id)\n        .outerjoin(MedicalEvent, \n                   (MedicalEvent.animal_id == Animal.id) & \n                   (MedicalEvent.event_type == \"Spay/Neuter\") & \n                   (MedicalEvent.event_date >= six_months_ago))\n        .outerjoin(Vaccination,\n                   (Vaccination.animal_id == Animal.id) &\n                   (Vaccination.vaccine_type == \"Rabies\") &\n                   (Vaccination.status == \"Completed\"))\n        .outerjoin(Veterinarian, MedicalEvent.veterinarian_id == Veterinarian.id)\n        .filter(completed_rabies_subq.c.animal_id.is_(None))\n    )\n\n    results = query.all()\n\n    # Convert to Pydantic models\n    records = [VaccinationsMissingRabiesOut.model_validate(row) for row in results]\n\n    return {\"records\": records}"
